meta.verified_by: Two-pass verification: (1) DOL WHD State Minimum Wage Laws page (updated 2026-07-01); (2) DOL WHD Tipped Employees table (revised 2026-07-01) - basic-rate column independently confirms every jurisdiction; cross-checked against Paycom/Rippling/Mappr 2026 compilations. Discrepancy found and resolved: one commercial site served stale pre-July Oregon rates.
meta.scope_v1: Federal + 50 states + DC + GU/PR/VI. City/county ordinances EXCLUDED (v2). Tipped minimums INCLUDED.
meta.disclaimer: Educational reference only, not legal advice. State labor offices are authoritative. Local ordinances may set higher rates.
